Type: frameless square wall mirror
Use: grooming, reflecting light; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: clear mirror glass, small metal mounting clips
Colors: silver reflective glass, chrome clips
Shape: large near-square panel with straight polished edges, held by slim clips along the top and bottom, flush to the wall, light and quiet
Feel: clean, bright, crisp, open
Goes with: white tiles or walls, chrome fittings, light wood vanities; minimalist or modern bathrooms and hallways
